articles.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX soars 20% in blockbuster Nasdaq debut
articles.snippet: The stock was trading above $160 in volatile action after last night's IPO at $135.

articles.title: XRP sentiment falls to 8-month low, and that has been a buy signal before
articles.snippet: Santiment's weighted sentiment gauge for XRP just hit its weakest reading since October 2025. The firm notes the token's strongest rebounds have tended to start when the crowd was this checked out.

articles.title: SEC plan to scrap ‘Rule 611’ positive for tokenized US stocks: Galaxy
articles.snippet: Galaxy’s Alex Thorn says a plan to scrap rules on stock orders and quotes would remove a major barrier to tokenized stocks trading on decentralized platforms.

articles.title: Avalanche Treasury falls 16% as it debuts on Nasdaq
articles.snippet: Avalanche Treasury holds about 15 million of the blockchain’s native token, AVAX, which is trading at a five-year low.

articles.title: Hungary to reverse crypto trading crackdown after EU scrutiny
articles.snippet: Hungary’s government said it will unwind crypto trading restrictions that required approved validation for conversions and exposed users and service providers to criminal liability.
